status_summary: On 2025-04-29 EPA released its final ESA Insecticide Strategy with reduced buffer distances, credit for treating a smaller share of a field and for qualifying conservation programs, and updated data sources; the release does not describe USDA or state pesticide usage data as driving the strategy. On 2026-05-01 EPA released a draft ESA Fungicide Strategy for a 60-day comment period (docket EPA-HQ-OPP-2026-2973) and stated it expects to finalize it no later than November 2026; EPA's strategy page cites about 41 million acres treated with fungicides each year in the lower 48 states, without naming a data source. No change to the ESA's treatment of pesticide benefits was found; that part would need congressional action.

timeline.event: EPA released its final Insecticide Strategy with flexibilities for states and growers; the release names USDA as a federal partner and refers to updated data sources but does not mention pesticide usage data.

EPA released the draft Fungicide Strategy for a 60-day public comment period in docket EPA-HQ-OPP-2026-2973, closing 2026-06-29 per EPA, stated it expects to finalize the strategy no later than November 2026, and cited about 41 million agricultural acres treated with fungicides each year in the lower 48 states.

title: Reform Endangered Species Act review of pesticides and use actual usage data
uncertainties: EPA's pages do not say that USDA or state usage data drive the strategies; the statement that the draft incorporates acres-treated data rests on a University of Illinois Extension article dated 2026-07-06, which does not name the data source or mention USDA. EPA's release page gives a 60-day period closing 2026-06-29, while the extension article gives 2026-07-20 as the comment deadline; the difference was not resolved. A Federal Register API search for the fungicide docket number and strategy title found no notice, so no Federal Register document was available. Whether the fungicide strategy was finalized by October 2026 was not confirmed, and no ESA amendment bill was searched.
